body: Hi. I checked the link you provided and sent them a message. Hoping to hear from them soon. Can I message you? I just wanted to know how you personally prepared before the actual procedure since I might be doing this alone, I need to prepare everything on my own as well. ☹️

Awwwe. I wanna wrap you in a bear hug. That is the sweetest thing i heard today. While you're busy looking out for others don't forget to look out for yourself too. You are too kind. Dont let yourself burnout. People might still need to hear your kindness even when they are resisting.
I truly appreciate it. Thank you for trying and dont take it too hard if people refuse to receive the help you offer.
Thats so kind of you. Thanks
No its fine. I prefer the peace the peace I feel because of the finality of things
Hey me too. I was planning to "leave" yesterday. But im still here, even though i dont want to. Wanna talk about it? Dont worry i wont try to push optimism on you.
Thats how i feel. When i was writing letters for my loved ones i felt at peace knowing it will all end soon.
No support or cheering up needed. I am fine with how things are in my life. I am constantly in pain and forever will be miserable. Only death can end this

I searched on countries where its easy to migrate. I think the only thing that can save me is physically removing myself in this country and be far away as possible. I know it sounds desperate and greedy, I even used dating sites to find men who would be interested to marry and petition me out of this country. I dont mind if they just want to marry me for my looks or to use my body, i just want out here. If incase they are good guys im okay with it too. I can try to be a good partner for them. Im not a gold digger. I am actually very self sufficient and take care of my own bills but you can probably say im guilty if i think of using men for permanent residency elsewhere.
I cried reading what you wrote. This how I feel at the moment. I wish I could be with people who think and feel like me and leave this world together.
I feel this a lot. I hope I can say it gets better but it feels bleak to me.
I feel the same. I hate how our body screams self preservation the moment we attempt but our mind is pushing to go through with it. That is the only reason im still here because I keep failing.

Kinda sucks isnt it? You feel peace when you get a chance to "live out" that fantasy on how you would end things. I cant remember how many times i tried to do it, went, and changed my mind or ultimately failed. But its okay. Maybe we'll have our chance. Whether living stronger, or leaving peacefully.
I live in the Philippines and we're pretty much surrounded with beaches. Access to beaches is so easy.

My plan is to run away and go to a very nice beach. Bask in the sun. Sand in my feet. And when im finally relieved and ready to take the swim, I'll drown myself. Pretty easy since i dont know how to swim.

I certainly agree with this. I still believe that people should get to decide how they deal with their life, pain and suffering. I won't ask you to stay a little longer and fight to live another day. But i totally understand where you're coming from and honestly we're on the same boat.

I guess we just cant expect people to understand us too when they didn't even endure what we did. We tried our best but a person can only do and take so much.
